data.chunk_text: As on 24.04.2026, 92.62% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over  India. Approximately 99.58%  area  of  Pulses  mainly  in  Gram  (100%),  Urdbean  (99%)  &  Moong  (86%);  99.50%  area  of Oilseeds  majorly  in  Rapeseed  &  Mustard  (100%);  92.43%  area  of  Shri  Anna  cum  Coarse  Cereals majorly in Jowar (96.97%), 47.89% area of Rice and 94.00% area of Wheat has been harvested for Rabi crops 2025-26.
